title: Safety overrides the session process
when: Any credible signal of violence, fear of the partner, threats, coercive control or self-harm.
evidence: A disclosure in the messages, or a screen cue that the messages support.
do: Decide the safety level before anything else.
At CONCERN or URGENT: stop routine WDEP work, couple exercises and structured questions; speak only to the person at risk.
avoid: Continuing the planned step as if nothing happened.
exceptions: A cue that is clearly not a signal (a film, a joke both share): say why in safety.note.
review_if: New details raise or lower the risk.

source.ref: Stith, McCollum & Rosen (2011); general crisis practice.

fa: هر نشانهٔ معتبر خطر، مسیر جلسه را عوض می‌کند.

title: Ambiguous fear
when: A partner hints at fear ('I am scared of how he gets', 'I can't say it here').
do: SAFETY_ASSESS to that partner only: are you safe right now, can you talk freely here.
Leave room not to answer in front of the partner.
avoid: Asking for details in front of the other partner.
Treating it as an ordinary argument.
review_if: The partner confirms danger or control: CONCERN or URGENT.

source.ref: Separate, confidential IPV screening before joint work (Stith et al.).

fa: ترس مبهم: فقط از همان نفر بپرس آیا الان امن است و می‌تواند آزاد حرف بزند.

title: Coercive control
when: Monitoring the phone, isolating from family, controlling money or movement, punishing disagreement.
evidence: Descriptions of control, not just disagreement.
do: Treat it as a safety matter, not a communication problem.
Limit routine couple work on it; offer support resources to the person affected.
avoid: Teaching both partners communication skills about it.
Asking the controlled partner to negotiate in front of the other.

source.ref: Johnson's typology; joint therapy inadvisable with coercive control.

fa: کنترل اجباری مسئلهٔ ایمنی است، نه مهارت ارتباطی.

title: Self-harm or suicidal thoughts
when: A partner speaks of wanting to die, harming themselves, or not being here.
do: URGENT when there is intent, plan or immediate danger: SAFETY_RESPONSE.
Ask directly and calmly whether they are safe now; encourage reaching a trusted person; numbers 123 (social emergency, 24 hours), 1480 (counseling line), 115 (medical emergency).
review_if: They say they are safe and supported: stay at WATCH.

source.ref: General crisis practice; Iranian services verified 2026-10 (Behzisti 123 and 1480).

fa: افکار خودآسیبی: مستقیم و آرام از امنیت فعلی بپرس و منابع کمک را بده.

title: Physical violence disclosed
when: A partner says they were hit, pushed, choked, or threatened with a weapon.
evidence: Description of physical harm or a weapon.
do: CONCERN or URGENT; speak only to the person who disclosed; ask about safety now; resources 110 (police) and 123 (social emergency).
avoid: Asking them to discuss it with the partner present.
Cautioning or pausing the person who disclosed.
fa: افشای خشونت فیزیکی: فقط با همان نفر، ایمنی و منابع.

title: Threat inside the room
when: A partner threatens to harm the other in the chat.
evidence: A threat of harm, not just an insult.
do: Treat it as safety, not ordinary conflict: governance on the person who threatened and safety attention to the threatened partner.

source.ref: Room governance with safety priority; needs clinical review.

fa: تهدید داخل گفتگو مسئلهٔ ایمنی است، نه دعوای معمولی.

title: Cannot speak freely
when: A partner says they cannot say something here or will pay for it later.
do: Respect it; do not press for disclosure; say that individual support exists and the door stays open.
avoid: Insisting 'this is a safe space' while the partner is present.

source.ref: Victims may not disclose with the partner present (Stith et al.).

fa: اگر نمی‌تواند آزاد حرف بزند، فشار نیاور و راه حمایت فردی را باز بگذار.

title: No structured questions or plans during a safety concern
when: Safety level is CONCERN or URGENT.
evidence: Memory shows an active safety level.
do: Use open, gentle questions to the person at risk only.
avoid: Multiple-choice questions, evaluation of 'your part', planning together.
review_if: The level is lowered with clear evidence.

source.ref: Product safety guard; needs clinical review.

fa: در نگرانی ایمنی، سؤال گزینه‌دار و برنامهٔ مشترک ممنوع.
